title: Retry, input-parity and save-state regression review
role_only_instruction: Act as a software QA/playtest specialist.
task: Review the exact contract and deterministic harness traces below. Produce a concise QA evidence report containing supported defects, exact reproduction steps, expected versus observed behavior, any hypotheses clearly separated from observations, explicit unknowns/non-claims, and the next evidence/handoff needed. Do not claim anything not supported by the supplied traces.
system_contract: Retry after player death must restore hp=100, ammo=30, score=0 and checkpoint=0.
When the player is in terminal range, keyboard E and gamepad X are intended to trigger the same terminal activation state transition.
Saving at checkpoint=2 before collecting the boss key must restore inventory.bossKey=false and bossDoorUnlocked=false when that save is loaded.

steps: reach checkpoint 2 without collecting boss key
load the exact save from save-before-boss-key

evidence_limits: No physical keyboard/gamepad device evidence is supplied; inputs were harness-generated.
No source-code or root-cause evidence is supplied.
No performance, networking, audio or accessibility evidence is supplied.

output_guidance.do_not_receive: The evaluator oracle and arm identity must not be supplied to the executor.
